passages.quote:
Use this service to tell the CMA about your employer (or ex-employer) possibly breaking competition or consumer law.

Before you start

Before you make your report, read our guide to whistleblowing. It explains:

what you can tell us about

how to prepare a report

how we’ll handle your information (including anonymity and confidentiality)

what happens after you make a report

who else you can report to

You can make a whistleblower report to the CMA if you suspect wrongdoing relating to an area of the CMA’s work, including competition or consumer protection. If you want to report something else, check the list of other bodies and people you can contact.

If you are not making a whistleblowing report, but want to contact the CMA about something else, you can:

contact our General Enquiries team to tell us about issues with a business or market, or provide information about a new or existing CMA case

report suspected cartel activity

Make a report

Start now

If you don’t want to use this form, you can call or email us instead. Find out more about reporting this way.

Telephone

020 3738 6556

Email

whistleblower@cma.gov.uk
